title: ThreatListPro daily feed totals (one row of data/history/daily.csv)
description: Totals for the full ThreatListPro IPv4 feed, recorded once per UTC day. Counts only; the entries themselves are not published.

baseline.description: true for the first snapshot, which has no previous list to compare with

entries.description: Number of IPv4 addresses and IPv4 CIDR blocks in the full feed

unique_ipv4_addresses.description: IPv4 addresses covered by all entries, overlapping ranges merged

added.description: Entries present now but not in the previous snapshot

removed.description: Entries in the previous snapshot but not present now

list_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the full feed's entries joined by LF, no trailing newline
